errors.text: The proposed L1_2 precipitate intervention does not reconstruct the Ti-induced fcc+C14 Laves dual-phase intervention or rapid-quench processing.
Neither cited source provides magnetic, coercivity, or domain-wall-pinning evidence; both concern mechanical strengthening or ductility.
No composition, precipitate fraction, size distribution, heat treatment, or quantitative coercivity target is specified, so the intervention and falsification threshold are not operationally defined.
